info.title: SalesCaptain API Documentation Service
info.description:
API Documentation Service for SalesCaptain platform.
This service provides endpoints for managing and retrieving company information for API documentation purposes.

post.summary: Send a message in a conversation
post.description:
Sends an outbound message in the given conversation for the specified company.
`company_id` and `conversation_id` are taken from the URL path. `message_body` is required in the JSON body.
Optional `template_id` can be provided to send a template message.
`account_id` is resolved from the authenticated user's account that matches `company_id` (same as other company-scoped routes).
The request is forwarded to the chat service as a POST with `company_id` and `conversation_id` in the path.

message_body.description: Plain text body of the message to send
message_body.example: Hi — this is a test message from the api-doc send endpoint.

template_id.description: Optional SMS template ID used when sending a template message

post.description:
Retrieves inbound and outbound call analytics grouped by account for one or more companies.
`company_ids` is required (comma-separated UUIDs).
`start_time` and `end_time` are optional; if either is missing, the last 6 months is used.
Durations are in seconds.
`call_count` / `total_duration` are inbound; `outgoing_*` are outbound.

start_time.description: Start of the analytics window (must be provided with end_time)

end_time.description: End of the analytics window (must be provided with start_time)

value.error: company_ids is required
Both start_time and end_time must be provided together, or omit both to use the last 6 months

example.error: You don't have access to call analytics for one or more companies!

Message.description:
Message information object.
`media` and `recording_url` are mutually exclusive by presence based on `type_of_message`:
for non-call messages the response includes `media` and omits `recording_url`;
for call messages the response includes `recording_url` and omits `media`.

media.description:
Media attachments (e.g. image/file URLs).
Present only when type_of_message is not call. Omitted for call messages (replaced by recording_url).

recording_url.description:
Call recording URL.
Present only when type_of_message is call. Omitted for non-call messages (replaced by media).

call_status.description: Status of the call when the message is a call (null for non-call messages)
